source: Production Crate public catalog fields only; SELECT statements only.
counting: occurrences counts unnest rows, title_count deduplicates repeated identical tags within each title. Case and spelling preserved. Example title is lexicographically first title carrying that exact tag.
queries: SELECT tag, count(*) AS occurrences, count(DISTINCT tmdb_id) AS title_count, min(title) AS example_title FROM (SELECT unnest(essence_tags) AS tag, tmdb_id, title FROM movie WHERE essence_tags IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY tag ORDER BY occurrences DESC, tag ASC LIMIT 1000000

SELECT tag, count(*) AS occurrences, count(DISTINCT tmdb_id) AS title_count, min(title) AS example_title FROM (SELECT unnest(essence_tags) AS tag, tmdb_id, title FROM show WHERE essence_tags IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY tag ORDER BY occurrences DESC, tag ASC LIMIT 1000000
archive_note: Large source exports are gzip-compressed. Dataset sha256 values describe decompressed original JSON bytes; archive_sha256 describes the saved gzip file.
